claims: Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12, 2026.
Rory McIlroy became the fourth player in history to win back-to-back green jackets.
Rory McIlroy finished 12-under par in the 2026 Masters.
Scottie Scheffler was the runner-up in the 2026 Masters.
Scottie Scheffler finished 11-under par in the 2026 Masters.
Tyrrell Hatton, Russell Henley, Justin Rose, and Cameron Young tied for third in the 2026 Masters.
Rory McIlroy's six-stroke lead vanished during the third round of the 2026 Masters.
The 2026 Masters winner's share was $4.5 million.
The 2026 Masters purse marked a new record.
The final round of the 2026 Masters was at Augusta National.
Final round coverage of the 2026 Masters aired on CBS from 2-7 p.m. ET.
Final round streaming of the 2026 Masters was available on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Fubo.
